title: Prove sharp equivariant rounding radii for integer reflections
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Resolve Open next question 1 of Nick Petalas's merged #5079. For the nonorthogonal reflection `A_1(x,y)=(x+y,-y)`, the least uniform infinity-norm error of an integer-valued equivariant rounder is exactly `floor(2m/3)/m` on the complete grid `(1/m)Z^2`, and `2/3` on `R^2`. One compatible rule attains every grid optimum and fixes integer inputs.

The same proof determines the exact radius for every integer shear reflection `A_k(x,y)=(x+k*y,-y)`, including the odd-grid correction, with explicit attaining witnesses. The real optimum grows as `|k|/4+O(1)` despite fixed dimension two and group order two. This adds a sharp precision requirement to the predecessor's existence theorem; no predecessor verifier is replayed.

[Proof and formula table](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab8cc5917fbc76564367a973bd6cd1ed5a22ee3/research/reflection-rounding-radius/PROOF.md), [scope and reproduction](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab8cc5917fbc76564367a973bd6cd1ed5a22ee3/research/reflection-rounding-radius/README.md). This is a scoped written proof with finite corroboration, not a physical supplier, #4100 caller discharge, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem. The complete input domain is essential to the minimax claim. Actual reader reachability, paid arithmetic/tape costs, dirty restoration and supplier/outer admission remain open. Independent human and proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.

Predecessor #5079: `43f558c1b8fc14fb0ed33a4512fbc976beea6b0f`; its retained README is pinned by blob/SHA256 at the scientific base. Publication rebased onto canonical main `20a1e31bc6009b9b3f4d084bbaadc6350e34fcba`, with unchanged guidance, selected record and scientific input.

[Advance claim and canonical result thread #5100](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5100); [handoff reply](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19142644). The complete submission snapshot covered 303 open PRs, 4,253 Discussion records and all 6,824 main-tree notes, followed by a live PR/Discussion refresh immediately before submission. No competing same-question claim was found in that coverage. #5079 and #1631/#1892 are merged predecessors. Other recent krzysztofwojt topics were excluded. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside coverage.

## Validation

Exact contribution head: `dab8cc5917fbc76564367a973bd6cd1ed5a22ee3`. CPython 3.12.12 / macOS; standard library only. Normal and isolated optimized registered replays pass under the refreshed shared tooling:

- 357 complete grids, 44,268 residues and 2,017,390 candidate integer outputs in a separately implemented exhaustive box oracle.
- 44,982 small equivariance/error cases, 7,380 larger grid attaining fixtures, 205 real-radius witnesses and 820 integer fixed-point checks.
- Eight rejecting controls cover omitted orbit/vertical error, wrong transport and ties, understated radius, and missing grid/parity corrections.
- Publication-byte and full source-history preflight pass for all nine package/input files. Official export integrity and read-only, Git-free isolated optimized replay pass with the same computed table digest.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reflection-rounding-radius
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/reflection-rounding-radius --check-source-history
```

The registered pair takes about 15 seconds locally. The universal/real-input assertions rest on the written proof, not the finite census. [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab8cc5917fbc76564367a973bd6cd1ed5a22ee3/research/reflection-rounding-radius/VALIDATION.md) gives counts, controls and evidence boundaries. No selected cold replay, predecessor scientific suite, Lean or Docker run was performed.

Hosted [run 39934724438](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39934724438) failed before this package ran: eight existing onboarding-fixture assertions fail after #5102. A clean detached sparse worktree at the unchanged baseline `20a1e31bc6009b9b3f4d084bbaadc6350e34fcba` independently reproduces exactly those eight failures in 11 affected tests (4.45 seconds): seven are preempted by `working source drift: scripts/check_research_commit.py`; one lacks `research_package` in the standalone overlap fixture. The new research package is absent from that checkout. JoyboyBrian already owns the focused repair in #5123; this PR does not duplicate it or alter shared/frozen files. No hosted package pass is claimed yet.

Krzysztof Wojt with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and bounded Luna support, Apache-2.0. The primary agent derived/checked the proof and integrated the package; Luna inventoried claims/source scope, implemented the independent box oracle and checked bounded parity arithmetic. Nick Petalas supplies #5079's theorem, invariant norm, stabilizer-compatible construction and explicit next question. Retain Sricharan Vagvala #1631, woklerx #1892, Sagar Thakrar #1537, Ross Richardson #1287 and the #1227/#889/#1203 output-frame/dirty-echo lineage.

The [open next questions](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/blob/dab8cc5917fbc76564367a973bd6cd1ed5a22ee3/research/reflection-rounding-radius/README.md#open-next-questions) are actual-reader reachability of a maximizing orbit, and a larger finite group's stabilizer-compatible covering radius. Each has a first step and blocker; neither is reserved.

Scope of merge: eight new files in one isolated research package. Shared code, frozen sources and the selected frontier are unchanged.
